urdu transliteration:
JITNE BHI MASAEB HON, NA GHARAIYO ZAINAB 
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
No matter how many hardships come, do not lose courage, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
ASHURKI SHAB AAI, ALAMDAAR TUMHI HO 
IS QAAFELE KI QAAFELA SALAAR TUMHI HO
BACHON KI KHABAR LUJIYO, BEHLAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
The eve of Ashura has arrived; now you are the standard-bearer.
You are the leader of this caravan.
Take care of the children and comfort them, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
KHOJAA YE SAKINA TO, USE CHUNDH KE LAANA 
HO BAAPKE SINEPE TO AAHISTA, UTHAANA
BABA NAHIN AB AA YENGE, SAMJAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
When Sakina goes missing, embrace her and bring her back.
You will find her lying upon her father's chest, lift her gently.
Explain to her that her father will not return now, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
KHAIMONME LAGE AAG TO, AABID KO JAGAANA
CHIN JAAE RIDAA SARSE TO, AANSU NA BAHAA
QAIDI BHI BANAAE TO, CHALI JAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
When the tents are set ablaze, awaken Abid (Imam Zain-ul-Abideen) and recue him.
When your veil is snatched from your head, do not shed tears.
Even if they take you captive, continue onward, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
LE JAAEN AGAR SHAAMKE, DARBARME SHAAMI 
TANZIL KI KHAATIR PAAE, SAJADE GIRAAMI 
TUM SAATH BHATIEKE, CHALI JAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
When you're brought into the courtyard of Yezid
The revered Sajjad (Imam Zain Ul Abedeen) will be humiliated
Remain by your nephew's side and accompany him, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
JAB SHAAMKE BAZAARSE, SAR NANGE GUZARNA
GHABRAAKE SITAMSE KABHI, FARYAAD NA KARNA
BAS BHAAI KA SAR DEKHKE, REH JAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
When you pass through the marketplaces of Sham with your head uncovered,
Do not become overwhelmed by oppression and cry out in despair.
Simply keep your gaze upon your brother's severed head, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
ROEGI MERI YAAD ME DIN RAAT SAKINA
MARJAAEGI ZAINDAAN MEN, GHUT GHUTKE SAKINA
ZINDAAN MEN MAASUMAAKO, DAFNAAIYO ZAINAB
HAR ZULMO SITAM SHAANSE SEH JAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
Sakina will weep for me day and night.
In the prison she will slowly waste away and die.
Bury the innocent child in the dungeon, O Zainab.
Bear every oppression and cruelty with dignity, O Zainab.

urdu transliteration:
QAIDE SITAMSE SHAAME, JAB CHHOTKE JAANAA
RUDDADE AALAM NANAKE RAWZEPE SUNAANA
DURRONKE NISHAAN AMMAAKO, DIKHLAAIYO ZAINAB
english translation text:
When you are finally released from the captivity of Sham,
Go and narrate the tale of these sufferings at our Grandfather's shrine.
Show Mother the bruises left by the whips, O Zainab.
